description="Message logging system"

name="busybox syslog"
command="/sbin/syslogd"

command:
set -eu
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
suffix=$(printf '%s' "$boot" | tr -d '-')-$$
auth_marker="AUTH-FACILITY-$suffix"
authpriv_marker="AUTHPRIV-FACILITY-$suffix"
normal_marker="NORMAL-DAEMON-$suffix"
logger -p auth.info -t auth-route-test "$auth_marker"
logger -p authpriv.notice -t auth-route-test "$authpriv_marker"
logger -p daemon.notice -t normal-route-test "$normal_marker"
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  if grep -F "$auth_marker" /var/log/auth-events.log >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -F "$authpriv_marker" /var/log/auth-events.log >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -F "$normal_marker" /var/log/messages >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
  i=$((i+1))
done
printf '%s\n' '--- dedicated authentication log ---'
grep -F "$auth_marker" /var/log/auth-events.log
grep -F "$authpriv_marker" /var/log/auth-events.log
printf '%s\n' '--- ordinary system log ---'
grep -F "$normal_marker" /var/log/messages
printf '%s\n' '--- separation assertions ---'
if grep -F "$auth_marker" /var/log/messages >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: auth marker leaked into messages'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'PASS: auth marker absent from messages'; fi
if grep -F "$authpriv_marker" /var/log/messages >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: authpriv marker leaked into messages'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'PASS: authpriv marker absent from messages'; fi
